ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels in the central region and 15% low-intensity black pixels localized on the perimeter and notch base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central blob. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and tips. A distinct cluster of three dark ellipsoidal spots is located in the medial-posterior region of the right lobe. A dark, jagged pixel cluster is visible at the junction of the peduncle and the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; depth is partially obscured by water turbulence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; peak-to-valley depth varies between 3 to 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior curvature on both lobes, transitioning to an acute, tapered sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of three discrete, high-contrast dark oval clusters on the right lobe, arranged in a linear-diagonal constellation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three dark, roughly circular pigment marks or scars on the right lobe; several small tan/yellowish localized pixel clusters near the fluke center suggesting biological growth or superficial lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific triangular configuration of the three dark spots on the right lobe provides a unique spatial identifier.
